objective: Correct singleton-candidate presence F1 so true-negative rows do not inflate the positive-class score, then recompute protocol-matched LOAO presence metrics from frozen prediction files.
dataset: FABSA official validation and test splits
protocol: 12-fold all-row LOAO with one held-out aspect per fold
selection_rule: Reuse every frozen prediction, threshold, checkpoint, prompt, and parser decision; perform no model selection, inference, training, or test-guided tuning.
aggregation: Unweighted mean, population standard deviation, minimum, and maximum across the 12 held-out aspects, reported separately for validation and test.
commit_scope: Metric implementation, regression tests, recomputation script, configuration, and aggregate audit report only. Raw review text and prediction JSONL remain local under ignored outputs/.
cost: No new model calls or training; deterministic recomputation only.
